name: McMaster University
header:
McMaster University
Canada · Mathematics MSc (thesis or project); PhD following MSc / transfer
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 201-250. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc is the evidenced entry route from a UChicago bachelor’s, with possible PhD transfer.
• Submit early enough to trigger two reference requests before February 1, 2027.
• No fee waiver.
• University doctoral minimum is not a verified mathematics MSc offer.
• International OGS materials and deadline are departmental; generic donor-award dates for current 2026-27
students are not Fall 2027 entrance deadlines.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
Bachelor’s applicant should apply to MSc. The international guideline generally asks first-class standing / 85%
each year; McMaster must translate UChicago grades. The July 2024 handbook gives B+ in the final two years
and about ten upper-level math/stat courses, so confirm the stricter international assessment. PhD normally
follows MSc; handbook directs applicants without a Canadian MSc toward research MSc, with PhD interest
stated and possible transfer after one year. F-1 alone does not establish Canadian study authorization. [b] [c] [f]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose thesis or project MSc; identify relevant faculty, prepare transcript and one-page interest statement, ask
two academic referees, then pay and submit. Research admission needs a willing supervisor; contact faculty
early. Obtain confirmation of English-medium instruction if not stated on the transcript. [a] [b] [f]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact potential supervisors before applying where possible; research admission requires faculty willingness
to supervise. Shortlist below concentrates on the four current algebra/AG/number-theory faculty, with official
recent paper verification. Harada is on leave in 2026-27; Rajchgot until January 2027. Neither leave listing
establishes unavailability for autumn 2027. [a] [f] [j] [l] [m]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public SGS instructions explain program selection, research questions, uploads, payment, final submission and
eReferences. Mosaic access follows the submission-confirmation email. Technical problems:
sgsonl@mcmaster.ca; program questions: msgrad@mcmaster.ca. [a] [d] [e]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
International department page explicitly gives February 1, 2027; scholarship page explicitly covers 2027-28.
Handbook is July 2024, and stipend amount is an undated university minimum rather than a 2027 math
guarantee. [b] [f] [g] [h]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
International applicants: complete application and supporting materials by February 1, 2027 for full
consideration; timezone not stated. Department encourages early January completion. Standing portal
schedule opens November 1 and closes April 30; after February 1 review is space-dependent, not assured.
September intake only. [a] [b]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Use February 1, 2027 for admission/full consideration. No separate mathematical funding-priority date
published. International OGS is departmental nomination; 2027-28 fast facts say contact program for
early-2027 faculty allocation, with no exact public math nomination date. CGRS-M deadline December 1, 2026
applies only if Canadian citizen, permanent resident or protected person. [a] [b] [h] [i]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All applicable supporting materials must be received for the February 1, 2027 full-consideration application;
timezone and any reference/test grace period are not published. Arrange references before submitting; email
invitations are triggered only after submission. [b] [d]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal 2027 acceptance date located in the admissions/after-application pages. The individual offer and
funding letter must supply the response date; do not assume April 15. [a] [e]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
International guideline accepts graduation from an English-instruction university if this is clearly documented
on the transcript; otherwise listed tests include TOEFL iBT 92, IELTS 6.5 overall with every component at least
5.5, MELAB 85, PTE 63 and specified language-program routes. Current page still uses the older TOEFL scale;
confirm 2026 test-scale equivalence if testing. [a] [b]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English-medium degree should meet the stated degree-based route (inference), but guideline
specifically asks the transcript to state the instruction language. Confirm whether a registrar letter is
acceptable if the UChicago transcript omits this; neither F-1 status nor studying in the US by itself is the
published exemption. [b]
GRE General [Standing rule]
GRE is not required by the department. Submission permission, weight and whether General scores would be
considered are not stated. [a]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Department says GRE not required without separating General and Subject. No Mathematics Subject Test
requirement or recommendation located; acceptance/weight of unsolicited scores remains unverified. [a]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Disclose every postsecondary institution and upload transcripts; unofficial copies suffice for review. Accepted
students must arrange final official records directly from institutions, plus degree certificate if conferral is
absent. If applying before fall grades, update once available. PDFs must be unlocked, at most 5 MB each and
10 MB total across uploads. [a] [d]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list or course-description document appears in the public required-document
list. Portal-only fields and permission to add unsolicited material are unverified. [a] [d]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two confidential academic references from instructors familiar with the applicant’s academic work. [a] [f]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
International OGS uses departmental nomination; public sources do not reveal additional referee count or
questions. Ask math for its nomination instructions. AwardSpring permits reuse of a reference/statement
among internal awards having the same criteria, but this does not establish reuse of admission letters. [h] [i]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central operational instructions explicitly send the email only once the application is complete and submitted.
Department shorthand says entering email sends a request but omits that prerequisite; follow the more
specific central sequence. [a] [d]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: invitations are sent after final submission, not merely saving referee details. Paying alone is insufficient:
return and click Submit. [d]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Mosaic provides a document checklist after the confirmation email, usually within a few days. A Required flag
can remain until program staff manually update it; contact the program if receipt is uncertain. [e]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Referee identity or email can be changed through Mosaic after submission. Whether a submitted admission
letter can be replaced, carried to another program or reused next cycle is not publicly specified. Internal
AwardSpring sharing is a separate feature. [d] [i]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume; Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample /
thesis / research summary; Publications list [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required admission document in the public mathematics checklist. No prompt, limit,
formatting or upload-versus-link permission established. A research proposal is required for a later MSc-to-PhD
transfer, not shown as an ordinary MSc application requirement. [a] [f]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required Statement of Interest, one page. Faithful prompt paraphrase: identify the mathematics/statistics
areas you want to study so faculty can assess fit. No word count, font, spacing or margin rule published. Upload
as PDF under central file-size rules; a link is not specified as a substitute. [a] [d]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in the required one-page Statement of Interest; portal may additionally request a proposed topic and
supervisor names. No separate research-interest essay specified. [a] [d]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list or course-description document appears in the public required-document
list. Portal-only fields and permission to add unsolicited material are unverified. [a] [d]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
International OGS nomination materials/prompts and extra references must be obtained from the department;
no public math-specific form/length found. Internal AwardSpring may request statements and references and
permits sharing where criteria coincide. Do not draft an assumed generic scholarship essay. [h] [i]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Central application Questions responses allow up to 4,000 characters including spaces per response; exact
program questions are not public. Review portal before drafting. [d]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
University-wide eligible doctoral minimum is annual full-time tuition plus CAD 17,500. This is not a verified
mathematics offer or net amount after supplementary fees. Most research master’s students receive
substantial funding, but no exact 2027 math MSc package or summer breakdown was publicly located. [g] [i]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Mathematics MSc thesis normally 20 months, project 10-12 months; PhD program normally four years. These
academic durations are not an established funding guarantee: require the offer to specify years, summers and
renewal terms. [c] [f] [g]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students may receive research-degree support and merit awards. International OGS is
nomination-only; Canadian CGRS-M legal-status restrictions may exclude the applicant. McMaster Graduate
General Bursary excludes international graduate students. [g] [h] [i]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time doctoral support is subject to Graduate Calendar criteria. Nearly all math graduate students
undertake paid TA work included in the admission funding offer; July 2024 handbook gives typical 266
hours/year. Students are expected to apply for eligible scholarships; confirm 2027 TA hours, fees, health costs
and grant components in the offer. [f] [g]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary departmental funding form located. For international OGS, contact the department for
nomination instructions and internal deadline. Internal donor awards use AwardSpring and can have additional
requirements. [a] [h] [i]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGS is CAD 15,000 for one year; international nomination eligibility and permit timing need department
confirmation. Richard Fuller Memorial Scholarships admit incoming/current international Science MSc/PhD
candidates and may renew up to three years. Howard P. Whidden targets non-Canadians from Commonwealth
countries (citizenship not known); do not assume eligibility. International CGRS-D applicants must already be
enrolled in an eligible Canadian doctorate when applying. [h] [i]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 150 non-refundable. Valid credit card; domestic Interac only via Google Pay. Return to the application
after payment and submit. [d]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Department FAQ explicitly says it cannot waive the application fee for any reason. [a]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Jenna Rajchgot
Schubert and quiver varieties, equivariant K-theory, combinatorial commutative algebra and degenerations. [j]
[l] [o]
Current Associate Professor; on leave until January 2027. Autumn 2027 availability unverified.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Combinatorial proofs of the type A quiver component formulas
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Megumi Harada
Equivariant algebraic/symplectic geometry, Hessenberg varieties, Newton-Okounkov bodies and geometric
representation theory. [j] [l] [m] [n]
Current Professor and Canada Research Chair; not teaching in academic year 2026-27 / on leave. Check 2027 supervision.
Research evidence: 2024 · Gröbner geometry for regular nilpotent Hessenberg Schubert cells
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Adam Van Tuyl
Combinatorial commutative algebra: toric and edge ideals, syzygies, homological invariants and projective
point configurations. [j] [l] [p]
Listed as current faculty; availability to accept a 2027 student must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Partial Betti splittings with applications to binomial edge ideals
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.
Number theory
Cameron Franc
Modular forms and L-functions, modular-group representation varieties, vertex algebras and arithmetic
geometry. Official page lists older papers; latest 2025 paper independently verified on author-deposited arXiv.
[j] [q] [r] [s]
Current Associate Professor, despite stale Assistant title on personal homepage; 2027 availability unverified.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · The moduli space of representations of the modular group into G_2
Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.

Canada · Mathematics MSc (thesis or project); PhD following MSc / transfer
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 201-250. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written

Pay attention to
• MSc is the evidenced entry route from a UChicago bachelor’s, with possible PhD transfer.
• Submit early enough to trigger two reference requests before February 1, 2027.
• No fee waiver.
• University doctoral minimum is not a verified mathematics MSc offer.
• International OGS materials and deadline are departmental; generic donor-award dates for current 2026-27
students are not Fall 2027 entrance deadlines.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
Bachelor’s applicant should apply to MSc. The international guideline generally asks first-class standing / 85%
each year; McMaster must translate UChicago grades. The July 2024 handbook gives B+ in the final two years
and about ten upper-level math/stat courses, so confirm the stricter international assessment. PhD normally
follows MSc; handbook directs applicants without a Canadian MSc toward research MSc, with PhD interest
stated and possible transfer after one year. F-1 alone does not establish Canadian study authorization. [b] [c] [f]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose thesis or project MSc; identify relevant faculty, prepare transcript and one-page interest statement, ask
two academic referees, then pay and submit. Research admission needs a willing supervisor; contact faculty
early. Obtain confirmation of English-medium instruction if not stated on the transcript. [a] [b] [f]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact potential supervisors before applying where possible; research admission requires faculty willingness
to supervise. Shortlist below concentrates on the four current algebra/AG/number-theory faculty, with official
recent paper verification. Harada is on leave in 2026-27; Rajchgot until January 2027. Neither leave listing
establishes unavailability for autumn 2027. [a] [f] [j] [l] [m]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public SGS instructions explain program selection, research questions, uploads, payment, final submission and
eReferences. Mosaic access follows the submission-confirmation email. Technical problems:
sgsonl@mcmaster.ca; program questions: msgrad@mcmaster.ca. [a] [d] [e]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
International department page explicitly gives February 1, 2027; scholarship page explicitly covers 2027-28.
Handbook is July 2024, and stipend amount is an undated university minimum rather than a 2027 math
guarantee. [b] [f] [g] [h]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
International applicants: complete application and supporting materials by February 1, 2027 for full
consideration; timezone not stated. Department encourages early January completion. Standing portal
schedule opens November 1 and closes April 30; after February 1 review is space-dependent, not assured.
September intake only. [a] [b]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Use February 1, 2027 for admission/full consideration. No separate mathematical funding-priority date
published. International OGS is departmental nomination; 2027-28 fast facts say contact program for
early-2027 faculty allocation, with no exact public math nomination date. CGRS-M deadline December 1, 2026
applies only if Canadian citizen, permanent resident or protected person. [a] [b] [h] [i]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All applicable supporting materials must be received for the February 1, 2027 full-consideration application;
timezone and any reference/test grace period are not published. Arrange references before submitting; email
invitations are triggered only after submission. [b] [d]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal 2027 acceptance date located in the admissions/after-application pages. The individual offer and
funding letter must supply the response date; do not assume April 15. [a] [e]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
International guideline accepts graduation from an English-instruction university if this is clearly documented
on the transcript; otherwise listed tests include TOEFL iBT 92, IELTS 6.5 overall with every component at least
5.5, MELAB 85, PTE 63 and specified language-program routes. Current page still uses the older TOEFL scale;
confirm 2026 test-scale equivalence if testing. [a] [b]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago English-medium degree should meet the stated degree-based route (inference), but guideline
specifically asks the transcript to state the instruction language. Confirm whether a registrar letter is
acceptable if the UChicago transcript omits this; neither F-1 status nor studying in the US by itself is the
published exemption. [b]
GRE General [Standing rule]
GRE is not required by the department. Submission permission, weight and whether General scores would be
considered are not stated. [a]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Department says GRE not required without separating General and Subject. No Mathematics Subject Test
requirement or recommendation located; acceptance/weight of unsolicited scores remains unverified. [a]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Disclose every postsecondary institution and upload transcripts; unofficial copies suffice for review. Accepted
students must arrange final official records directly from institutions, plus degree certificate if conferral is
absent. If applying before fall grades, update once available. PDFs must be unlocked, at most 5 MB each and
10 MB total across uploads. [a] [d]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list or course-description document appears in the public required-document
list. Portal-only fields and permission to add unsolicited material are unverified. [a] [d]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two confidential academic references from instructors familiar with the applicant’s academic work. [a] [f]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
International OGS uses departmental nomination; public sources do not reveal additional referee count or
questions. Ask math for its nomination instructions. AwardSpring permits reuse of a reference/statement
among internal awards having the same criteria, but this does not establish reuse of admission letters. [h] [i]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Central operational instructions explicitly send the email only once the application is complete and submitted.
Department shorthand says entering email sends a request but omits that prerequisite; follow the more
specific central sequence. [a] [d]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: invitations are sent after final submission, not merely saving referee details. Paying alone is insufficient:
return and click Submit. [d]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Mosaic provides a document checklist after the confirmation email, usually within a few days. A Required flag
can remain until program staff manually update it; contact the program if receipt is uncertain. [e]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Referee identity or email can be changed through Mosaic after submission. Whether a submitted admission
letter can be replaced, carried to another program or reused next cycle is not publicly specified. Internal
AwardSpring sharing is a separate feature. [d] [i]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume; Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample /
thesis / research summary; Publications list [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required admission document in the public mathematics checklist. No prompt, limit,
formatting or upload-versus-link permission established. A research proposal is required for a later MSc-to-PhD
transfer, not shown as an ordinary MSc application requirement. [a] [f]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required Statement of Interest, one page. Faithful prompt paraphrase: identify the mathematics/statistics
areas you want to study so faculty can assess fit. No word count, font, spacing or margin rule published. Upload
as PDF under central file-size rules; a link is not specified as a substitute. [a] [d]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in the required one-page Statement of Interest; portal may additionally request a proposed topic and
supervisor names. No separate research-interest essay specified. [a] [d]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course list or course-description document appears in the public required-document
list. Portal-only fields and permission to add unsolicited material are unverified. [a] [d]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
International OGS nomination materials/prompts and extra references must be obtained from the department;
no public math-specific form/length found. Internal AwardSpring may request statements and references and
permits sharing where criteria coincide. Do not draft an assumed generic scholarship essay. [h] [i]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Central application Questions responses allow up to 4,000 characters including spaces per response; exact
program questions are not public. Review portal before drafting. [d]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
University-wide eligible doctoral minimum is annual full-time tuition plus CAD 17,500. This is not a verified
mathematics offer or net amount after supplementary fees. Most research master’s students receive
substantial funding, but no exact 2027 math MSc package or summer breakdown was publicly located. [g] [i]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Mathematics MSc thesis normally 20 months, project 10-12 months; PhD program normally four years. These
academic durations are not an established funding guarantee: require the offer to specify years, summers and
renewal terms. [c] [f] [g]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students may receive research-degree support and merit awards. International OGS is
nomination-only; Canadian CGRS-M legal-status restrictions may exclude the applicant. McMaster Graduate
General Bursary excludes international graduate students. [g] [h] [i]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full-time doctoral support is subject to Graduate Calendar criteria. Nearly all math graduate students
undertake paid TA work included in the admission funding offer; July 2024 handbook gives typical 266
hours/year. Students are expected to apply for eligible scholarships; confirm 2027 TA hours, fees, health costs
and grant components in the offer. [f] [g]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary departmental funding form located. For international OGS, contact the department for
nomination instructions and internal deadline. Internal donor awards use AwardSpring and can have additional
requirements. [a] [h] [i]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGS is CAD 15,000 for one year; international nomination eligibility and permit timing need department
confirmation. Richard Fuller Memorial Scholarships admit incoming/current international Science MSc/PhD
candidates and may renew up to three years. Howard P. Whidden targets non-Canadians from Commonwealth
countries (citizenship not known); do not assume eligibility. International CGRS-D applicants must already be
enrolled in an eligible Canadian doctorate when applying. [h] [i]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 150 non-refundable. Valid credit card; domestic Interac only via Google Pay. Return to the application
after payment and submit. [d]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Department FAQ explicitly says it cannot waive the application fee for any reason. [a]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
International guideline’s first-class/85%-each-year rule is stricter than handbook B+ final-two-year wording.
Referee email shorthand on departmental page is clarified by central after-submission rule. Current directory
lists Franc/Rajchgot as Associate Professors although their personal homepages still say Assistant. [a] [b] [d] [f] [j]
[q] [r] [t]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Ask msgrad@mcmaster.ca for US grade equivalence, exact 2027 MSc funding and duration/fees/summers,
international OGS nomination deadline and document/referee prompts, English-medium proof format, any
portal-only CV/short answers, submitted-letter replacement/reuse, and individual offer response date. Confirm
supervisor availability, especially current leaves. [a] [b] [d] [e] [g] [h] [i] [j]

International students may receive research-degree support and merit awards. International OGS is

General Bursary excludes international graduate students. [g] [h] [i]
